LanguageData.MMD_ParanoidDelusion.label: Persecutory delusional disorder
LanguageData.MMD_ParanoidDelusion.description: The patient believes everyone intends to kill them, avoids social contact, and treats injury or hostility as justification for execution.
LanguageData.MMD_MajorDepression.label: Major depressive disorder
LanguageData.MMD_MajorDepression.description: Psyfocus is unusually stable and efficient, but positive feelings fade rapidly and an episode may lead to a genuine suicide attempt.
LanguageData.MMD_Schizophrenia.label: Schizophrenia
LanguageData.MMD_Schizophrenia.description: The patient believes a legendary figure lives inside their mind and manifests real abilities matching that identity.
LanguageData.MMD_Mania.label: Mania
LanguageData.MMD_Mania.description: The patient possesses extreme speed, strength, and drive, but has little neural heat capacity and is highly prone to episodes.
LanguageData.MMD_OCD.label: Obsessive-compulsive disorder
LanguageData.MMD_OCD.description: Orderly work is faster, but compulsive checking interrupts tasks and unmet compulsions reduce mood and productivity.
LanguageData.MMD_PanicDisorder.label: Panic disorder
LanguageData.MMD_PanicDisorder.description: Sudden panic can occur without danger or after injury. The patient moves quickly but works and aims poorly during the aftermath.
LanguageData.MMD_IntermittentExplosive.label: Intermittent explosive disorder
LanguageData.MMD_IntermittentExplosive.description: The patient is dangerous in melee and may erupt into a brief berserk rage when injured, followed by remorse.
LanguageData.MMD_Narcissistic.label: Narcissistic personality disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Narcissistic.description: Praise produces confidence and strong social performance, while insults or rejection cause a severe crash.
LanguageData.MMD_ADHD.label: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
LanguageData.MMD_ADHD.description: The patient learns and moves quickly, starts tasks intensely, then loses focus and may abandon prolonged work.
LanguageData.MMD_SocialAnxiety.label: Social anxiety disorder
LanguageData.MMD_SocialAnxiety.description: The patient functions well alone, but crowds reduce mood, social ability, and work speed and encourage avoidance.
LanguageData.MMD_PersistentDepressive.label: Persistent depressive disorder
LanguageData.MMD_PersistentDepressive.description: A chronic low state with efficient psycasts but reduced productivity when mood falls. Episodes cause sad wandering, not suicide.
LanguageData.MMD_Schizotypal.label: Schizotypal personality disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Schizotypal.description: The patient cycles between withdrawn focus and active strange beliefs with increased psychic sensitivity and impaired social function.
LanguageData.MMD_Hypomania.label: Hypomania
LanguageData.MMD_Hypomania.description: The patient cycles between stable and hypomanic phases. Hypomania improves mood, work, and movement but consumes more rest.
LanguageData.MMD_GeneralizedAnxiety.label: Generalized anxiety disorder
LanguageData.MMD_GeneralizedAnxiety.description: Injured or unhappy colonists and nearby fires accumulate as worries, progressively impairing mood, work, and aim.
LanguageData.MMD_Dissociative.label: Dissociative disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Dissociative.description: Brief losses of reality interrupt work and leave a period of reduced mood, productivity, and learning.
LanguageData.MMD_SomaticSymptom.label: Somatic symptom disorder
LanguageData.MMD_SomaticSymptom.description: Stress is interpreted as physical illness, causing the patient to interrupt work and seek medical rest.
LanguageData.MMD_PTSD.label: Post-traumatic stress disorder
LanguageData.MMD_PTSD.description: The patient remembers a traumatic damage source. Re-exposure can trigger a flashback and uncontrolled flight or retaliation.
LanguageData.MMD_Catatonia.label: Catatonia
LanguageData.MMD_Catatonia.description: Movement and work are slowed and may stop abruptly. A full episode causes genuine catatonic shutdown.
LanguageData.MMD_Insomnia.label: Insomnia disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Insomnia.description: The patient works well at night and tolerates wakefulness, but restores rest slowly and may wake abruptly.
LanguageData.MMD_AdjustmentDisorder.label: Adjustment disorder
LanguageData.MMD_AdjustmentDisorder.description: Develops after trauma or prolonged low mood. It impairs mood and work while stressed, but can resolve after sustained stability.
LanguageData.MMD_SpecificPhobia.label: Specific phobia
LanguageData.MMD_SpecificPhobia.description: The trauma is tied to one specific time of day, entity, weather, animal species, person, human group, furniture type, or item. While the source is absent: mood +6, positive memory duration ×1.2, negative memory duration ×0.8. Longer exposure causes stronger and longer-lasting mood penalties; while a penalty remains, both memory multipliers are reversed.
LanguageData.MMD_Agoraphobia.label: Agoraphobia
LanguageData.MMD_Agoraphobia.description: Safe rooms improve mood and work, while open exposed spaces cause escalating anxiety, impaired aim, and panic.
LanguageData.MMD_AvoidantPersonality.label: Avoidant personality disorder
LanguageData.MMD_AvoidantPersonality.description: The patient works well alone but especially avoids people they value, fearing exposure and eventual loss.
LanguageData.MMD_DependentPersonality.label: Dependent personality disorder
LanguageData.MMD_DependentPersonality.description: The patient attaches to a partner or trusted companion, becoming calm nearby and distressed by separation or loss.
LanguageData.MMD_OCPD.label: Obsessive-compulsive personality disorder
LanguageData.MMD_OCPD.description: The patient works quickly and precisely but repeatedly interrupts tasks to inspect details and cannot tolerate incomplete work.
LanguageData.MMD_Cyclothymia.label: Cyclothymic disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Cyclothymia.description: The patient cycles over several days between a low, slow phase and an elevated, productive phase.
LanguageData.MMD_BodyDysmorphic.label: Body dysmorphic disorder
LanguageData.MMD_BodyDysmorphic.description: The patient repeatedly checks their appearance. Checking briefly improves performance; prolonged inability reverses the benefit.
LanguageData.MMD_IllnessAnxiety.label: Illness anxiety disorder
LanguageData.MMD_IllnessAnxiety.description: The patient is medically attentive but interrupts work to seek examinations; reassurance helps temporarily.
LanguageData.MMD_Borderline.label: Borderline personality disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Borderline.description: The patient fixates on an important person and alternates between idealization and devaluation after negative interactions.
LanguageData.MMD_BipolarII.label: Bipolar II disorder
LanguageData.MMD_BipolarII.description: The patient cycles between a debilitating depressive phase and a productive hypomanic phase.
LanguageData.MMD_DissociativeAmnesia.label: Dissociative amnesia
LanguageData.MMD_DissociativeAmnesia.description: An episode temporarily suppresses several levels of one skill. The skill returns after about two days.
LanguageData.MMD_Anorexia.label: Anorexia nervosa
LanguageData.MMD_Anorexia.description: The patient frequently refuses food until dangerously hungry, reducing recovery and increasing incoming damage.
LanguageData.MMD_Bulimia.label: Bulimia nervosa
LanguageData.MMD_Bulimia.description: The patient cycles between restriction and uncontrolled eating, followed by a brief high and then a severe crash.
LanguageData.MMD_BipolarI.label: Bipolar I disorder
LanguageData.MMD_BipolarI.description: The patient cycles between severe depression and full mania with extreme productivity and rest consumption.
LanguageData.MMD_DID.label: Dissociative identity disorder
LanguageData.MMD_DID.description: The patient alternates between protector and caregiver identities with distinct combat, medical, and social strengths.
LanguageData.MMD_Schizoaffective.label: Schizoaffective disorder
LanguageData.MMD_Schizoaffective.description: The patient cycles through depressive, manic, and psychotic phases with different mood, work, social, and psychic effects.
LanguageData.MMD_Cotard.label: Cotard delusion
LanguageData.MMD_Cotard.description: The patient denies death and reality itself. If a corpse remains after death, they immediately return to life.
LanguageData.MMD_Claustrophobia.label: Claustrophobia
LanguageData.MMD_Claustrophobia.description: Open space is comforting, while small enclosed rooms severely impair mood and work and may provoke panic.
LanguageData.MMD_Hyperthymesia.label: Hyperthymesia
LanguageData.MMD_Hyperthymesia.description: The patient cannot forget: skill experience never decays and all positive and negative mood memories persist forever. Congenital only.
LanguageData.MMD_MentalEtiology.label: mental etiology record
LanguageData.MMD_CognitiveStabilizer.label: mind stabilizer chip
LanguageData.MMD_CognitiveStabilizer.description: An implanted neural regulator that cures and prevents all mental disorders and grants a permanent +12 mood.
LanguageData.MMD_Hippocampectomy.label: hippocampectomy
LanguageData.MMD_Hippocampectomy.description: The hippocampus has been removed. Existing skills are fixed forever: they can neither improve nor decay, and the patient cannot suffer a mental break.
